---
name: code-review
description: Use when a diff is ready and the question is whether this change is safe to merge.
---

# Code review

Read the diff and the acceptance criteria. Check that priority is validated, stored, defaulted to Medium for existing rows, selectable in the form, and filterable on the dashboard.

Confirm the existing authentication and validation tests are still in the run. Report defects against the criteria. Do not expand the review to the whole repository.
